instruction: Search for hotels in San Francisco on TripAdvisor.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent spent 5 turns passing TripAdvisor verification slider, then searched for NYC hotels and reached the hotel listing page. Opened calendar to change dates but got confused about day-of-week mapping. Never sorted by price. Ran out of turns with malformed final action.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can pass TripAdvisor verification slider, search for cities in TripAdvisor search box, navigate to hotel listing pages, interact with date picker calendar
metadata.failure_analysis: Model wasted too many turns on verification slider (5 of 13 turns). After reaching hotel page, struggled with date selection in calendar and never attempted to sort by price. Final turn produced malformed tool call.
metadata.explanation: Tests same hotel search capability as original but with a different city (San Francisco). Evaluator checks URL pattern matches TripAdvisor hotel listing for San Francisco. Uses URL pattern matching for robustness.
metadata.task_rationale: Model proved it can search TripAdvisor for a city and reach hotel listings (demonstrated with NYC). This variation tests generalization to a different city.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'active_url_from_accessTree' correctly extracts the active Chrome tab URL, which is the right state to verify navigation to a hotel search page.
Metric 'is_expected_url_pattern_match' correctly receives the rules dict (via type='rule') and accesses rules['expected'] to get the regex patterns - proper parameter handling.
Regex pattern 'tripadvisor\.com.*[Hh]otels.*San.Francisco' correctly verifies all instruction requirements: TripAdvisor domain, hotel search, and San Francisco city.
Complete coverage: the single instruction requirement (search for hotels in SF on TripAdvisor) is fully verified by the URL pattern check.
No postconfig needed - URL state persists after navigation, no transient UI state to capture.
